instruction.text: Choose the correct form of the passive to complete the sentence.

wrong.text: The past participle of the verb is always used to form the passive, no matter which tense the sentence is in.

atoms.b: New music is ((++made maked make)) every day.
I am ((++loved love loving)) by my family.
Are grapes ((++grown grow growing)) in the UK?
The car was ((++washed wash washing)) by my dad.
The work was ((++ruined ruin ruining)) by the dog.
When was the pizza ((++finished finish finishing))?

instruction.text: Choose the correct verbs to complete these sentences in the passive.

atoms.b: My owner ((++is are)) ((++guided guides)) by me every day.

hint.text:
To form the present passive, the present form of 'to be' is added to the past participle of the main verb.

For example, I am helped.

atoms.b: I ((++am is)) always ((++invited invite)) to parties.
They ((++were was)) ((++questioned question)) by the students.

hint.text:
To form the past passive, the past tense form of the verb 'to be' is added to the past participle of the main verb.

For example, I was helped.

atoms.b: I ((++was were)) ((++told tell)) to wait here.
